suite: Riot restore and sign-ins nobody owns
name: says in the plan that the backup keeps an unowned sign-in, and pins the snapshot the switch takes

steps.title: Save the outgoing sign-in
steps.detail: Skipped: the client holds a sign-in (Riot account …1111) that no One Launch account owns, so it is left alone and not saved. To keep it, save it from that account's page before switching.

steps.title: Back up RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml
steps.detail: Copy {tmp}\Local\Riot Games\Riot Client\Data\RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml, encrypted, into a new snapshot folder so a failed switch can be rolled back. The newest 20 snapshots are kept.

changes.before: (saved sign-in for Riot account …1111, fingerprint acd093bd)

steps.title: Put the account's sign-in in place
steps.detail: Decrypt Alt's saved copy of RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml from the vault and write it over the file, whole, as the client itself left it (its sign-in, token write count and device cookie together): the swap confirmed by hand on the real client. The new content is written to a temp file and renamed over the original. The copy is never shown or logged.

steps.title: Start the Riot Client
steps.detail: Start the client with no arguments, as its own shortcut does. It signs in as riot_alt on its own from the saved sign-in.

steps.title: Wait for the client to come up
steps.detail: Poll the process list until RiotClientServices.exe is running, up to 0.04 s.

steps.title: Confirm the client signed in
steps.detail: Read what the client appends to its new run log (no tokens in it) until it reports a sign-in verdict, up to 0.04 s: the signed-in state (PendingProductContext), after which RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml names the Riot account id, which must be …3333; or the login page (PendingLoginStrategy), which hands over to you in the next step. Only an invalid_grant refusal marks the saved copy stale.

steps.title: Wait for you to sign in
steps.detail: Runs only if the client refuses the saved sign-in or does not sign in within 0.04 s. The client stays on its login page; you sign in there once as riot_alt with “Stay signed in” ticked and One Launch continues as soon as the log reports the sign-in, up to 0.0013333333333333333 min.

steps.title: Save the new sign-in
steps.detail: Runs only after a manual sign-in: the fresh sign-in replaces the stale saved copy.
